Solar PV and battery storage

HHS is an MCS accredited installer for PV solar systems and battery storage. It offers free appointments for solar designs, showing how panels and batteries can reduce your energy bills and carbon footprint.

  • Free solar design appointments
  • Panels, inverters and battery storage
  • Repairs and maintenance on existing systems

EV chargers

HHS installs a variety of EV chargers to suit the needs and tariffs of both customers and suppliers. It can advise on what suits you best, and how to get the most out of your charging.

  • Home chargers fitted to the wall
  • Advice matched to your tariff

Outdoor lighting

Lighting for pleasure and for security: garden schemes, summer houses and floodlit car parks.

  • Garden and patio lighting
  • Car park and street lighting

Recent projects, by name.

From a fishing lodge to a church car park. Photos are HHS’s own, from the projects page of its current site.

Gentleman’s fishing lodge and store

A beautiful lodge where private members rest and warm up after a day’s fishing. HHS also added electrical items and supplies to a customer’s private fishing stores furniture.

During After

Nottingham Croquet Club

A beautiful historic building. HHS converted rooms into new bar areas and changing rooms, and made the lighting and heating systems easier to use.

New kitchens and a house renovation

A family’s new kitchen and dining room with a fantastic view of the garden, and the electrical work on a full house renovation.

Church car park and hall lighting

The local church always had a problem with its dark car park. It is now lit up and safe to use. HHS also tested the emergency lights and fire alarm systems so the church could re-open.
